method.tracking_xy_metric: sqrt(mean(component errors squared over both xy components))
method.hip_target: Raw actor targets converted with each run physical scales; Oct01 hip scale .125.
method.reset_exclusion: done step and following 49 steps excluded; differences only between consecutive valid samples; displacement and heading null for windows containing done
method.estimated_velocity: student minus same-step pre-action truth; not post-action root velocity
method.per_joint_target_units: first eight rad, last two rad/s; wheel/leg raw magnitudes not directly comparable
method.spectrum: Mean-subtracted rectangular-window RFFT with one-sided Parseval weights; fixed 50 Hz sampling; 5-25 and 10-25 Hz bands; excludes windows with resets; not physics-substep or hardware spectra
method.arithmetic_comparison: Means of four per-case metrics are descriptive summaries, not pooled RMSE or statistical replication.
method.axis_specific_tracking: New policy vx/vy component RMSE additionally derived from post-step root velocity and the command, without changing the historical XY metric.

limitations: One environment and one seed per case; descriptive comparison, not reliability or statistical evidence.
Scenario overrides, command schedules and seeds match, but observation noise/reward/action mapping vary with each training configuration. No single-parameter causal attribution.
The Oct01 corrupted cases use joint-velocity noise ±1.5 rad/s; Sep29 uses ±0.5 rad/s. These are not matched-noise comparisons.
Fixed 30 ms actuator delay exceeds the Oct01 training delay range of 0-15 ms.
The fixed plane/material/reset cases disable mass, gain, COM and push randomization; this is not a complete domain-robustness test.
Physical hip targets precede actuator buffering and are not measured hardware actuator outputs.
Spectra use control-sampled 50 Hz simulation telemetry and do not establish hardware spectra or motor stability.
No video or hardware replay was run, and the Sep30 deceleration incident is not covered by the Sep24 frozen-input sensitivity test.
Cached comparison inputs are ROA policies; the old DWAQ comparison is only in the linked static analysis.
